scope: Pump.fun/PumpSwap/Solana memecoin-specific narrative/meta intelligence from alpha callers
scope_guard: Creator claims remain HUMAN HYPOTHESES, never truth. Validate against Slinky/LaserStream outcomes/economics whenever causal timestamp + entity resolution permit.

narrative_validation_v1.slinky_overlap: 6 mints (0.004% of Slinky's 622K mints, 4.1% of 147 claim pump mints)
narrative_validation_v1.limitation: Temporal alignment gap: Slinky v3 covers June 5 - July 14, 2026; only 7 claim pump mints fall in this window. 3 of those 7 (43%) match Slinky. Low absolute overlap is structural — alpha callers discuss a tiny fraction of Pump.fun mints.

strengths: Case-preserving base58 mint extraction (fixed from lowercased bug)
Date-aware publish time extraction from TG page headers
Deep pagination across 5+ channels reaching back to 2023
High diversity of claim types: entry, exit, risk, narrative, observation, regime
Temporal labeling: 252 EX_ANTE claims (predictions before outcome)
Creator claims properly labeled as HUMAN HYPOTHESES, not truth
limitations: Slinky v3 overlap is low (6 mints) due to temporal alignment gap and alpha callers discussing a small subset of Pump.fun mints
371 of 374 validations are UNRESOLVED — cannot verify claim accuracy against on-chain outcomes
892 of 1211 claims have AMBIGUOUS temporal labeling — cannot determine if prediction was made before or after the event
Only 5 priority trader channels (PikalosiCalls, Marlonalpha, alphacalls, jacalcooks, solanaalpha) have public content; Pr6sper, Cupsey, Cented, DVCS, Meggga personal channels are private/empty
No X/Twitter content acquired — Firecrawl could not scrape X profiles reliably

validation_truth.note: Low Slinky overlap is structural, not a bug. Alpha callers discuss a tiny fraction of Pump.fun's 622K mints, and only 7 of their pump.fun calls fall in Slinky's June 5 - July 14 capture window.

export_constraint.repo_state_leakage: N/A — narrative gold contains no repo code. However, current-snapshot narrative claims about mints may reference mints that appear in held-out repair tasks. The Qwen exporter MUST prevent current-snapshot narrative leakage into Git eval tasks.
export_constraint.held_out_repair_exclusion: For each held-out repair/task, construct evaluation against the narrative state available immediately BEFORE that task/commit, or exclude overlapping current-snapshot narrative from its training context.
